decision.explanation: Different. Ranking only the supplied conditions by gain-centered Welch query distance gives C03 (3.652 dB), C04 (3.750 dB), C01 (6.223 dB), then C02 (7.124 dB). The nearest condition, C03, exceeds its calibrated 3.228 dB threshold, so the calibrated rule requires rejection of every known label. The figures support that decision: Q01 combines a strong 5.3 Hz periodic component with substantial, upward-shifted energy around 16.16–16.23 kHz and additional 183.3/2019.6 Hz lines, whereas no reference reproduces the same low/high-band balance, envelope modulation, and time-domain periodicity. All reports have identical 10 s duration, 44.1 kHz sampling, 0.1 Hz FFT spacing, 43.07 Hz Welch spacing, one channel, and full reported coverage, so no resampling or duration correction is needed. FS amplitudes are digital levels only because acquisition gain is unknown.
